title: Nuverse
source: Nuverse (Chinese brand name: 朝夕光年, Zhaoxi Guangnian) is the gaming development and publishing brand of ByteDance (Beijing Zhaoxi Guangnian Information Technology Co., Ltd.), formally established as a brand in 2019. It has published titles such as One Piece Fighting Path, Dragon Raja-era titles, CSGO-adjacent products, and MARVEL SNAP (TGA Best Mobile Game 2022), and underwent a large-scale business contraction in November 2023. The Mainland China edition of this game is published and operated by Nuverse — per SEGA's official press release, SEGA concluded a publishing contract with Nuverse (Hong Kong) Limited, ByteDance's gaming division, making it responsible for management and operation in East Asia excluding Japan (Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, South Korea, Southeast Asia). The Mainland China edition launched on March 27, 2025. (Sources: Nuverse official site, SEGA press release, Baidu Baike)
